ov: The greater roadrunner, a long-legged ground cuckoo of the deserts of the southwestern United States and Mexico. It can fly a little but mostly runs, and pairs stay together for years. It is the largest cuckoo in the Americas.
rg: The southwestern United States and northern Mexico.
df: Insects, spiders, scorpions, centipedes, mice, small birds, lizards and young rattlesnakes.
fx: It usually runs at up to 20 mph (32 km/h), and has been reported at 26 mph, the fastest clocked for a bird that can fly.
Until about 8,000 years ago it lived in open forest rather than desert.
